name: Xianyanbao (显眼包)
blurb: A show-off who stands out; in 2023 it turned into a fond word for a fun, bold character
title: Xianyanbao (显眼包) Meme: Meaning, Origin & Trend
description: 显眼包 once meant an embarrassing show-off. In 2023 it became a fond word for bold, funny people who liven things up, and topped China's buzzword lists.
answer: 显眼包 (xiǎnyǎnbāo, roughly "conspicuous bag") originally described someone who is too flashy and loves to show off, to the point of embarrassing others. In 2023 Chinese internet users turned it into a mostly affectionate word for people, animals or things with a strong personality who dare to stand out and make everyone laugh. That year it made all three major buzzword lists: 咬文嚼字's top ten (December 4), 语言文字周报's top ten internet buzzwords (December 8) and the national language monitoring centre's top ten internet terms (December 12).

body: The word is built from 显眼 (conspicuous) plus 包, a suffix for a kind of person, as in 哭包 (crybaby). In its old sense it was criticism: someone who draws attention in an awkward way.

The 2023 sense flips it. Calling a friend a 显眼包 now usually means they are the life of the party, willing to look silly, dance badly in public or wear something outrageous. The official explanation on the 2023 list says it is used jokingly for people or things that are bold, distinctive and create a cheerful mood.

ul: "Our class 显眼包 danced on stage in a dinosaur costume."
"This dog is a total 显眼包: it poses for every camera."
Self-description: "I'll be the 显眼包, someone has to start the dancing."
Still used critically sometimes: "Stop being such a 显眼包 in the meeting."

body: After topping the 2023 lists, 显眼包 has become a normal part of everyday Chinese. Commentators read its rise as a sign that younger people welcome individuality and do not mind looking a little silly. Its tone still depends on context: among friends it is fond, in a serious setting it can still be a jab.

faq.a: Usually, now. It means a bold, fun person who stands out, though in a serious setting it can still mean an embarrassing show-off.

faq.q: What is the English for 显眼包?
faq.a: Something like "attention-grabber", "class clown" or "the life of the party", depending on tone.

faq.q: Which buzzword lists included 显眼包?
faq.a: 咬文嚼字's 2023 top ten buzzwords, 语言文字周报's 2023 top ten internet buzzwords and the national language monitoring centre's 2023 top ten internet terms.
